//: Eating and drinking: what auto-consume may reach for, and what it must leave alone. The rules live in src/game/survival/Consume.js; only the ids are here. Picking something by hand from the list is never restricted by any of this — it only decides what the two auto-consume buttons will put in a survivor's mouth unasked.

edibleDespiteFlag.//: The world marks these inedible because they want soaking or cooking to be pleasant, but a person really does eat them as they are. Everything else carrying that mark is left alone: raw grain, pulses, tea bags, seaweed, straw, fodder.

notMeals.//: Pantry stock, seasonings, condiments, pure fats, and the few things the world's own description rules out: uncooked rice ("virtually inedible when dry"), water still being treated, a wild mushroom that may poison or derange, a raw egg. Each is safe enough to eat by hand; auto-consume simply never chooses them.

notDrinks.//: Liquid in name only: oil, syrup and thick sweet things quench nothing, so they never count towards thirst. They are still food, and still edible by hand.

drinks.//: Untreated water is never taken by itself: boiling it is a decision, not an accident.

notFood.//: What is not food by nature. Categories the world already sorts things into, plus the materials a body cannot use: a bone, a hide, a tea bag and a plastic sachet are all comestibles as far as the data is concerned.

batch.//: How many units one click of the stepper takes; the last size chosen is remembered per viewer in the browser.

petFood.//: Prologue rule (29.09.2026): cat, dog and bird food is for animals. A survivor eats it only when starving: from the Starvation stage `fromStage` on (game-data/sustenance.json starvation.stages) or worse. Otherwise it is refused with a plain reason; auto-consume never takes it. Eaten, it leaves a standing mood entry of `mood` (stored units, shown times practice.json morale.scale) for `minutes`, fading from `fadeFromMinutes`, on top of the food's own dislike. Items are found by their CDDA use action (PETFOOD) and by `ids`.
petFood.label: Ate pet food
